title: 0.1.4 gate truth: installed-build UI smoke, widget tests, features_verify, mdBook and setup upgrade
acceptance: cargo xtask verify and cargo xtask features verify pass; cargo xtask installer-test installs the smoke identity, runs scripts/ui-smoke.ps1 against it, fails on unnamed invokable controls, and uninstalls; crates/pdfxi-app/src/ui/widget_tests.rs drives real widgets with egui_kittest; features_verify rejects missing evidence paths, ignored test citations and verified rows without a gui/cli host; mdbook build docs/book succeeds and docs/releases/0.1.4.md lists known limits; the real AppId setup installs cleanly after the stale 0.1.2 uninstall entry is removed.
notes: Phase 2 of the 2026-11-23 finish review, plus the remaining honest-gate fixes: inherited page resources preserved during form flatten, shared Start Menu group, ARCHITECTURE promises corrected, and the platform-close test updated for ADR 0010. CI stays out of scope by user instruction; Windows is the only verified target.
